subtitle: Mobile service robotics for SAR operations

about.title: About Us
about.description:
We are the ISAAC team, a group of students from the Politecnico di Torino.
Our passion is robotics and we aim to create innovative and creative robots to assist humans.

projects.title: projects
projects.description: Our projects are based on service robotics. We are currently working on two prototypes for search and rescue purposes: Rese. Q Mk1 and its evolution, Yields. Q Mk2. These projects are the combination of technical skills, thinking outside the box and collaboration between team members.

events.title: events
events.description: To show our work and share our passion for robotics, we participate in various events, such as conventions, fairs and orientation days. These are also great opportunities to work as a team and to build a stronger bond between team members.
